extraction.name: Arabic-Nougat
extraction.description: A suite of OCR models designed to convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text, along with the arabic-img2md dataset (13.7k paired samples) and arabic-books dataset (1.1 billion tokens).
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content from the Hindawi website
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Converting HTML to PDFs and extracting Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Converting HTML to PDFs and extracting Markdown text to create paired image-Markdown samples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Synthetic generation of Markdown representations from HTML content of Arabic book pages.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Promotes the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset, derived from Hindawi’s web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents. Documents with highly irregular or multi-modal layouts, such as those containing dense tables, charts, or images, may require additional preprocessing.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluation of Arabic OCR models; downstream NLP tasks.
